# Stage 3 results (generated by run_stage3.py)

Prespecified in [PLAN.md](../PLAN.md#stage-3-prespecification). Costs are mean implementation shortfall in bps of arrival notional on 20,000 test hours (seed 313), averaged over 5 runs (training seeds 111–115). Intervals are paired over test hours for run-averaged costs; run-to-run ranges are shown separately. Forecast metrics use the first 5,000 test hours.

## Gate C1: misspecification headroom (validation hours, seed 212)

Gap = fitted classical + planner cost − true model + planner cost, with the classical model fitted on run 0's 1,000 training hours. Pass: gap ≥ 0.15 bps and interval above zero. Headroom = best simple rule − true model + planner.

| Scenario | Setting | Gap (bps) [95% CI] | Gate | Headroom over best rule | Regime-aware model's gap | Filter check (trend R², moment-matched / particle) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A Signal on/off | prespecified | +0.24 [+0.18, +0.30] | **pass** | +2.15 [+2.01, +2.30] | +0.00 [+0.00, +0.01] | — |
| B Fast or slow trends | prespecified | +0.09 [+0.06, +0.11] | fail | +3.00 [+2.82, +3.18] | +0.01 [+0.01, +0.01] | — |
| B Fast or slow trends | severe | +0.15 [+0.11, +0.19] | **pass** | +3.32 [+3.13, +3.50] | +0.00 [+0.00, +0.01] | — |
| C Signal outliers | prespecified | +0.09 [+0.06, +0.12] | fail | +3.05 [+2.87, +3.23] | — | 0.758 / 0.758 |
| C Signal outliers | severe | +0.16 [+0.12, +0.19] | **pass** | +3.15 [+2.96, +3.33] | — | 0.797 / 0.797 |
